note: 2026-11-07 18:10Z: pilot session on login C (JIS-DESKTOP) got operator reply 'Login A' (meaning: give the work to login A). role_loader injected roles/supervisor.md (Login A) and stop_guard blocked the turn end demanding 'supervisor.py plan --login A' + a background watcher, which would have run A's supervisor loop on the wrong host and hidden a missing watcher on JIS-LAPTOP. Fix: role injection only on an explicit 'You are <role>' line or the start line; stop_guard must check the supervisor's host equals this host (mts_signal who) before blocking. Test: prompt 'Login A' alone injects nothing; fails on current code.
title: role_loader injects Supervisor on a bare operator reply 'Login A', stop_guard then forces plan/watcher on the wrong host
